title: KIT design language
text: Priority: correct > clear > good-looking. Looking good makes people willing use tool comfortable reading , must never cost first two. Keep design simple clean.

title: KIT design language
text: One lead per page. page exactly one primary button (nb-lime), example “開始校準” (“Start calibration”). Everything else supporting cast steps back visually. Results first, details later. click, first thing people see status box: one-sentence conclusion, two three key points, one table one chart. Parameter tables, logs, check tables, R code go details row, opened demand. Problems must seen. dangerous case “looks successful actually wrong”. anything needs attention, status plain 【完成】 (“Done”). Actions change results (skipping scale, treating codes missing values) clicked user, never done automatically. frame unit. Anything black frame either something can operate complete unit (button, input, one result, one chart). frames inside frames, decorative frames. Quiet supporting cast. Explanations, hints, technical details use hint size text-hint color, frame, collapsed default. First-time users can find ; experienced users slowed . Every page looks . page skeleton, components, wording. Learn one page can use others; learn kitJoin can use kitsUI. Plain language first. main screen uses short sentences Chinese commonly used Taiwan. English terms (function names, column names) go details downloaded files.

title: KIT design language

title: KIT design language
text: Colors defined role, role exactly one color. Background: whole page nb-page (-white); cards, inputs, tables, charts use nb-card. Light ; dark mode. Ink: text, frames, shadows nb-ink. Text color blocks always nb-ink, never white. white text black header row main data table. Lead: nb-lime used header, primary button, current tab, current step number, selected item dropdown. Never use text color. Brand links: nb-green (color logo’s dark green) links, progress bars, ✓, checkboxes. hover, nb-green-hover. Never use large background. nb-mint done nb-yellow needs attention (also used 【要重新執行】 (“Run ”)) nb-salmon stopped (also used danger button) nb-sky information Color must never signal. status box always text label: 【完成】 (“Done”), 【完成，但請注意】 (“Done, note”), 【停下來】 (“Stopped”), 【要重新執行】 (“Run ”); ✓ tabs ! checklists carry hidden text. Supporting text text-hint Disabled text text-disabled Lines line, line-soft Disabled frames border-disabled Emphasis text: “還差：…” (“Still needed: …”) uses text-todo; checklist ! uses text-decide; single problem list uses text-stop. Logo colors (logo-bean, logo-leaf) logo illustrations, never interface. Charts: categorical colors use colorblind-friendly Okabe–Ito palette, taken order: chart-blue, chart-orange, chart-green, chart-purple, chart-sky, chart-vermillion. Reference lines bands use chart-neutral; continuous values use chart-sequential.

title: KIT design language
text: Hierarchy comes weight size, switching typefaces. Use weights 400 700; header h1 may go 900. Secondary buttons “problem” checklist items use 500. Code, raw messages, values diagrams: JetBrains Mono (mono), falling back rounded typeface Chinese. Ligatures always (font-variant-ligatures: none), <- |> display typed. display: header h1 h4: section titles h5: subtitles, step card titles, primary button, first line status box body: body text small: tables, step summaries hint: hints, collapsible titles, group labels, version line smallest size hint (14px); anything smaller chart tick labels . Put half-width space Chinese English numbers: 「688 人」, 「依 SPSS 數值標籤」. Numbers four digits get thousands separators: 「3,389 人」.

title: KIT design language
text: Top-level components use bw-frame (2px) nb-ink. Table row dividers secondary buttons use bw-line (1.5px). Diagram grid lines use bw-hair (1px). Corners: everything radius (8px); progress bars radius-bar; step numbers radius-round. shadow-header: header . shadow-card: results, including status box, charts, current step card, primary button. shadow-sm: clickable things, including tabs, regular buttons, dropdowns, focused inputs. shadow: callouts, code, inputs (focused), finished -yet-available step cards, tables, secondary buttons. callout result, shadow; keeps status box always prominent box page. hover, move 1px right; shadow becomes shadow-hover. press, move way drop shadow; animation 80ms. current tab looks “pressed”: lime, shadow, offset 2px. user set “reduce motion”, offset animation. Keyboard focus: 3px focus outline, offset 3px outward. Tabs, file buttons, checkboxes need .

title: KIT design language
text: sections: sp-5. components section: sp-3. buttons row: sp-2. Content content-max (1140px) wide, centered; gutter left right, 1rem ≤ bp-tablet. settings results sit side side: settings left 1/3, results right 2/3; ≤ bp-tablet stack, settings top. Tables wide content, stretched; layout width, scroll sideways inside frame wider.

text: header uses full logo kit-logo (bean + KIT wordmark), 5.6rem tall; 3.6rem phones. browser tab icon uses bean, kit-mark. Leave clear space least 1/4 logo height sides. may sit nb-lime, nb-page, nb-card; status colors nb-green. change colors proportions, add frames shadows. Use alt="" tool name already next .

title: KIT design language
text: component lists purpose, R function, appearance, rules, don’ts. Live samples design system’s components page.

title: KIT design language
text: header tells users tool version; app exactly one, top. R: kit_header() (kit_theme.R), reads Version Date DESCRIPTION. nb-lime block, bw-frame frame, shadow-header. Full logo left (5.6rem tall); right tool name (display), one line tagline (bold), one line version (hint). provide: tool name (“KIT ×× 工具”, “KIT ×× tool”) tagline (database name · tool ). version line always ; needed reporting problems. change tool name testing data. Phones (≤ 576px): logo 3.6rem, h1 1.35rem. Don’t: put buttons navigation header; change logo’s colors proportions, put frame around .

title: KIT design language
text: Step tabs main navigation inside tool: row clickable blocks; current one lime, finished ones get ✓, -yet-available ones gray. Ordered workflow (kitsUI): ① 資料 → ② 題目校準 → ③ 連結 → ④ 受試者評分 (① Data → ② Item calibration → ③ Linking → ④ Respondent scoring), circled numbers. 準備 (Prepare) 做出資料（選一個） (Make data (pick one)) 其他工具 (tools) R: kitsUI uses navset_tab plus states kit_tabs_js(); kitJoin draws tab bar kit_navgroups(), real tabs tabsetPanel(type = "hidden"), updateTabsetPanel() works usual. White background, bw-frame frame, shadow-sm. Current tab nb-lime, shadow, moved 2px right (pressed look). Standalone small tools “使用手冊” (“User guide”): dashed frame, shadow, placed far right. Done: ✓ (nb-green), plus hidden text 「（已完成）」 (“(done)”). yet available: bg-disabled background, text-disabled text; hover, explains must done first. Needs re-running: ✓ removed. Tab names “noun + verb”: 檔案上傳 (file upload), 遺漏值處理 (missing value handling). ≤ 768px tabs stay one row scroll sideways; wrap. Don’t: wrap tabs another big frame; use numbers imply every step required steps actually alternatives.

title: KIT design language
text: “這一頁做什麼” (“page ”) one-line explanation top tab, collapsed default; first-time users open see steps. R: kit_tab_guide(goal, steps, output, technical = NULL, note = NULL, diagram = NULL). frame, hint size, text-hint color, faint line rule . “看步驟 ▸” (“See steps ▸”) underlined nb-green text. goal: one sentence, 30 characters. steps: 3–6 points. output: get. Optional: note extra notes, technical (one collapsed level), diagram (see Diagram). Don’t: open default; put settings buttons inside ; make card.

title: KIT design language
text: four kinds buttons, page one primary button; labels start verb say clearly happens click. R: kit_button(id, label, kind = "secondary"), kind "primary", "secondary", "danger"; regular button just default look shiny::actionButton(). nb-lime background, h5 size, shadow-card, height ≥ 48px. One per page, plus “下一步” (“Next step”) bottom. Regular button (actionButton() default): white background, bw-frame frame, shadow-sm, height ≥ 40px. Used -flow buttons “對，下一步” (“Yes, next step”). White background, bw-line frame, shadow, 0.85rem, weight 500, height ≥ 36px. Used download, select , example files, move /, copy. nb-salmon background, nb-ink text, bw-line frame, size secondary button; stays nb-salmon hover press. disabled uses disabled look (bg-disabled background), salmon. Used delete, remove, “這一回合不做” (“Skip round”). Disabled: bg-disabled background, text-hint text, border-disabled frame, shadow; use opacity. disabled primary button always “還差：…” (“Still needed: …”) line (see ReadyLine). Buttons links leave page end “→”. recommended option goes first says 「（建議）」 (“(recommended)”). download lead page (example, response file), use kit-download btn-primary. Don’t: write 「確定」 (“OK”) 「送出」 (“Submit”); put two lime buttons one page; use white text.

title: KIT design language
text: download button looks secondary button (⬇ icon + 「下載 CSV」, “Download CSV”), file name saved correctly every browser, Chinese names included. R: kit_download_button(session, id, label, filename, content, class = NULL), placed inside renderUI(); tests, click download kit_test_download(session, id). Appearance: <class="btn btn-default kit-download">, styled secondary button; add class = "btn-primary" lead page. file name decided button drawn; last segment URL, Content-Disposition (filename UTF-8 filename*), download attribute use file name. file written download clicked; written, red notification appears (disappear ) plain-language message kit_abort() . .csv, .zip, .html use MIME types; everything else (.sav, .csv.gz) application/octet-stream, browser add extra extension. app sets options(kitDesign.app = "kitJoin") .onLoad(): tells log app wrote ; file name Chinese, ASCII fallback name older browsers lowercase app name (「第一波.sav」 → 「kitjoin.sav」). Don’t: use shiny::downloadHandler() (Chinese file names become missing-download_sav browsers).

title: KIT design language
text: Inputs white black frame, label small hint ; default value common safest one. R: Shiny’s selectInput(), textInput(), radioButtons(), checkboxInput(); hints use .kit-hint. White background, bw-frame frame, radius. shadow-sm appears focus; dropdown open, selected item nb-lime. Checkboxes radio buttons always 20px, nb-green selected. 2–5 options: radio buttons, visible ; 5: dropdown. required fields, write 「（必填）」 (“(required)”); red asterisks. Advanced options go 「進階設定 ▸」 (“Advanced settings ▸”) (see Details). Values guessed column names get pale yellow bg-guess background, reminding users check . One field, two uses: column, files need “pick column file” others need “value every row” (cohort TDCYP, wave 2009). Use one dropdown can type ; add separate mode choice. group checkboxes needs group name; 8 row becomes table gets “select ”. Don’t: give inputs shadow (except focus); put dropdowns table without aria-label.

title: KIT design language
text: status box first thing look clicking primary button: four fixed labels, colors, wordings. R: kit_status(), kit_done_status() (switches needs-attention automatically warnings), kit_error_status(e, action, todo), kit_stale_status(run_label); rendered make_status_ui(). Four states: Appearance: bw-frame frame, shadow-card; prominent box page. First line: label + one-sentence conclusion, bold, h5 size. example 「【完成】串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。」 (“[Done] Join complete: 3,389 rows × 2,058 columns.”) : 3 points, things needing attention first, key results ; rest go 「還有 N 點」 (“N ”). stopped: always say , button link; R’s original message goes 「原始訊息」 (“Original message”). run, scroll status box top screen (kit_scroll_to()). key output status box one table one chart; add another “result summary” box. Don’t: invent new labels; put raw error message top level.

title: KIT design language
text: callout reminder know clicking; result, shadow. R: kit_callout(..., warn = FALSE). Cloud-version reminders look : banner header kit_cloud_banner(), usage notes bottom page kit_cloud_footer(sections, links) (small gray text; wording comes app); check whether cloud version kit_is_cloud(). Information (nb-sky): general extra notes, example 「外部連結不適用：……這不是錯誤」 (“External linking apply: … error”). Attention (warn = TRUE, nb-yellow): example 「資料裡有疑似遺漏值代碼，建議先到遺漏值處理」 (“data contain look like missing-value codes; suggest going missing value handling first”). Appearance: bw-frame frame, shadow; links inside bold nb-ink. one callout per block. can go status box, open separate callout. button, put outside frame. Don’t: use callout report results; put frame inside frame.

title: KIT design language
text: data table one leads results: white background, black header row, width follows content; long tables show first rows. R: kit_static_table(df) (integers get thousands separators automatically), kit_preview_table(df, priority_cols, n), kit_rows_note(nrow, ncol, shown_rows). White background, bw-frame outer frame, nb-ink header row white text. Thin bw-line lines rows, bg-stripe zebra stripes, small size. Numbers right-aligned, tabular figures. h4 title , plus one hint line: 「共 157 列，以下前 20 列。」 (“157 rows; first 20 shown .”). full table downloadable, 「▸ 全部（157 列）」 (“▸ (157 rows)”). Width follows content, layout width; wider, scrolls sideways inside .kit-table-scroll break layout. Column names: function output data keep English names; summary tables app builds may use Chinese; downloaded files keep original column names. Tables inside step cards outer frame use bg-stripe (pale) header row, black one. Don’t: stretch full page width; show hundreds rows .

title: KIT design language
text: Charts sit white card, chart answers one question; categorical colors use Okabe–Ito, taken order. plotly chart always passed kit_plotly_style() last, looks like part app. Colors: kit_chart_colors() (categorical), kit_chart_neutral() (neutral), kit_chart_sequential() (color scale continuous values). Look: kit_plotly_style(p) (plotly Suggests; app needs Imports: plotly); downloaded single HTML file needs app’s fonts: kit_plotly_fonts(p) (kit_plotly_style() already attaches default). kitsUI’s kit_chart.R: kit_chart_categorical() (recolors charts drawn kits categorical colors), kit_chart_role() (role colors). Recoloring kit_plotly_style() can swapped: touch colors set kits kitsUI. -screen chart downloaded HTML use reactive (styled ), identical. Card: nb-card background, bw-frame frame, shadow-card (CSS .js-plotly-plot); chart white background, downloaded PNG. Text: rounded typeface (sans), nb-ink; body 15px, legend hover box 14px, tick labels 13px text-hint. Title: left-aligned, bold, h5 (18px); wraps browser chart narrow. kits subtitle (<sup>) stays next line. Axes (every axis, including side--side panels): axis line nb-ink 1.5px, left bottom (box four sides), ticks pointing outward, grid lines line-soft, zero line line. single chart, kits outer frame removed; side--side panels (category probability curves, Wright map) outer frames become faint line rules, panels stay distinguishable. Hover box: white background, nb-ink frame, rounded typeface. Legend: frame; 4 items, longest item wider 20 columns (Chinese character counts 2), goes chart, horizontal, left-aligned; otherwise right. chart narrower 600px (phones) always goes . legend = "keep" leaves position unchanged. Color scale: heatmap-type traces switch kit_chart_sequential() (pale lime → bg-new → nb-green, darker larger values; minimum white, 0% empty -data cells stay distinguishable); colorscale = FALSE keeps original scale. Color bar text frame follow sizes colors . Toolbar: plotly logo; “download PNG”, zoom , zoom , reset original range; Traditional Chinese. Margins: equally small sides; grows automatically axes, legend, color bar fit; axis titles legend least 16px card edge, text never cut . Left unchanged: data, axis ranges ticks, specified colors, marker shapes, line widths dashes, hover legend text, chart height. Cohorts, scales, scores take chart-blue, chart-orange, chart-green, chart-purple, chart-sky, chart-vermillion order. plotly’s default colors replaced Okabe–Ito color position. Reference lines, bands, unjudged points use chart-neutral. Continuous values (pass rates ) use chart-sequential. title chart states question answers. Text chart follows kits’ original (English) translated: screen, downloaded chart, chart running kits R identical can go straight paper. Labels user typed (item IDs, domains, cohorts, waves, scale names) display typed, Chinese included. chart, one hint line Chinese explains read ; legend entries needed decision (example Kept Dropped linking chart) get Chinese meaning line. Leave least 1.2rem chart explanation ; explanation must overlap x axis. Download chart secondary button (HTML via htmlwidgets::saveWidget(); toolbar can also save PNG). Don’t: use plotly’s default colors default toolbar; change plotly fonts axis lines separately app; answer two questions one chart.

what: Details row, advanced settings, settings summary (Details)
title: KIT design language
text: details row holds “details” “results first, details later”: row collapsed small-text titles; open one takes full line. R: kit_details_row(...) wraps row kit_detail(title, ..., open = FALSE); advanced options settings area use kit_advanced(..., title = "進階設定"); one-line settings summary results uses kit_settings_line(parts). Titles small text-hint text ▸, frame. Opened content frame either; opened advanced settings get faint line rule left. provide: title detail (noun: 「題目參數」 (“Item parameters”), 「這一回合的紀錄」 (“Log round”), 「用 R 怎麼做」 (“R”)) content. Collapsed default. “用 R 怎麼做” (“R”) always last item details row. settings summary goes primary button results, one line small text: 「本回合 R1：M03、M36 · 參照世代 M03 · 沒有固定檔」 (“round R1: M03, M36 · reference cohort M03 · anchor file”). Don’t: use accordion cards; stack frames inside details.

what: “How to do it in R” panel (CodePanel)
title: KIT design language
text: “用 R 怎麼做” (“R”) turns current settings R code can run , always lives details row. R: kitJoin’s kit_code_blocks(snips), kit_code_panel(output_id); kitsUI’s component name. Collapsed, one line small text details row: 「▸ 用 R 怎麼做」. One line explanation: 「以下程式碼依你目前的設定產生，是簡化的示範。」 (“code generated current settings simplified example.”) version name (bold) 「複製」 (“Copy”) secondary button, line. code. code frame: bg-code background, bw-frame frame, shadow, code size. code frame content width layout (inside gutters) must break layout opened. two versions (tidyverse, base R), two “version name + code” pairs stacked. Ligatures always : <- |> display typed, copying hand introduce mistakes. 70 columns per line: code examples explanations, letters, digits, symbols count 1 column, Chinese characters 2. Break lines writing templates; display, kit_code() wraps automatically kit_code_wrap() (commas inside parentheses, comments spaces Chinese characters; parse result must wrapping), kit_code_cols() counts columns per line; lines still long wrapping (unbreakable long strings) raise warning (stop). Code still long scrolls sideways inside frame wrapped. Don’t: open default; use cards, icons, green header; stack frames inside frame.

title: KIT design language
text: Use step cards page several steps order: one step open time, finished steps collapse one line. R: module kit_stepcards_ui()／kit_stepcards_server(id, titles, summaries, checks); low level kit_step_card(), kit_step_head(), kit_step_body() (steps 1–3 kitJoin’s 「kits 作答檔」 (“kits response file”)). kit_steps() step list page guide, step card. Current step: white background, bw-frame frame, shadow-card; round number nb-lime. Collapsed one line: round ✓ nb-mint, followed one-sentence summary (example 「5 個檔案 · 世代 TDCYP · 2009、2011（年）」 (“5 files · cohort TDCYP · 2009, 2011 (year)”)), 「改」 (“Edit”) far right. Frame border-disabled, shadow. yet available: border-disabled frame, text-disabled text, says 「先完成第 1 步」 (“Finish step 1 first”). Move forward clicking 「對，下一步」 (“Yes, next step”) (regular button); go back finished step 「改」 (“Edit”). primary button sits steps, one; 「還差：…」 (“Still needed: …”) line (see ReadyLine). Tables cards outer frame pale header row; phones row becomes block (see FileTable). clickable area 「改」 least 32px, aria-label 「改第 N 步：標題」 (“Edit step N: title”); current step gets aria-current="step". Choose first, refine later: earlier steps ask minimum choices (example step 2 picks “columns items”); detailed settings edited later table (example item table step 3 sets domain scoring). explanation earlier step must say 「之後在第 N 步還能改」 (“can still change step N”), users think everything must set . Tables edit open directly: lead step table edit (example item table), show table directly, inside details row; put 「下載這張表」 (“Download table”) secondary button next , can downloaded time. Don’t: open several steps ; put cards inside cards.

title: KIT design language
text: checklist lists “things decide” together “things already fine”, placed conversion run. ! (text-decide): needs decision. One bold sentence, one line small text saying , decision buttons . ✓ (nb-green): fine, already decided. Weight 500; decisions user made say 「（你選的）」 (“(choice)”), 「改回來」 (“Change back”) next . (text-hint): reminder, decision needed. Thin line-soft lines rows. recommended option goes first, button says 「（建議）」 (“(recommended)”). problem counts decided click (suspected missing-value codes, insufficient information); decided, result’s status box remind . List needed; per-item table goes 「▸ 逐題看、逐題改（45 欄）」 (“▸ Review edit item item (45 columns)”), 25 rows per page, searchable. Marks get aria-hidden="true", preceded hidden text 「要決定：」 (“decide:”), 「沒問題：」 (“OK:”), 「提醒：」 (“Note:”). Don’t: list per-item reminders hundreds items.

title: KIT design language
text: primary button clicked yet, one line says still needed gives link fix . R: kit_ready_line(missing, link = NULL); server, kit_run_gate(session, output, missing, link) also disables button; enough files, kit_need_files(n_files, need = 2L). Appearance: one line bold text-todo 「還差：…」 (“Still needed: …”), followed nb-green link 「到「檔案上傳」加入檔案 →」 (“Go ‘File upload’ add files →”); disabled primary button . Show primary button (disabled) start, people know click end page. “Still needed” names concrete thing number: 「至少要 2 個波次的檔案，目前只有 1 個。」 (“Files least 2 waves needed; 1 now.”) server must still check; rely disabled button. Don’t: hide button; repeat thing yellow callout.

title: KIT design language
text: “下一步” (“Next step”) sits bottom right page, appears results , takes user next tab. R: kit_next_step(text = NULL, button_id = NULL, label = NULL, button = NULL). Appearance: hint sentence left (can list destinations), primary button 「下一步：××× →」 (“Next step: ××× →”) right. appears: status 【完成】 (“Done”) 【完成，但請注意】 (“Done, note”). Removed results outdated (【要重新執行】, “Run ”). button text names next page. Don’t: show results ; place middle page.

title: KIT design language
text: diagram uses small tables show page (→ ), placed “這一頁做什麼” (“page ”). R: kit_diagram(, , caption, arrow = "→"), tables kit_dg_table(df, title, added = NULL). Supporting cast: frame, tables wide content, bw-hair grid lines, pale nb-page header row. Values mono typeface. Newly added columns bg-new background 「（新）」 (“(new)”) column name, color cue. Empty cells say 「（空）」 (“(empty)”) gray. small table 2–3 rows uses generic names (id, score, wave), column names specific database. One hint line plain-language explanation . ≤ 576px, “” top, arrow points , “” . Don’t: use real data; use black header row large data tables.

title: KIT design language
text: file table settings table step cards upload pages “one row per file, one column per setting”; phones row becomes block. R: table.table.kit-file-table, data-label (column name) <td>; used kitJoin’s upload page, step 1 kits response file, kitsUI’s item bank selection table. Desktop: regular table; inside step cards, outer frame pale header row. ≤ 576px: table every row fill card width; row block, cell preceded hint line column name, line dividers rows. Button positions fixed every row: unused 「上移」「下移」 (“Move ”, “Move ”) get invisible placeholders (btn invisible, aria-hidden), buttons jump sideways. Cells guessed column names use bg-guess. Inputs layout width. Don’t: let whole page scroll sideways phones.

title: KIT design language
text: Every tab follows order top bottom (tabs one primary button use kit_run_tab_ui()／kit_run_tab_server(), handle fixed parts state flow; tab writes settings, run, results):
code: Header (one per app) Step tabs (current is lime, finished get ✓, not yet available are gray) What this page does: one sentence                         See steps ▸ Settings (left 1/3)          │ Settings summary and preview (right 2/3) Advanced settings ▸ Still needed: … (while it cannot be clicked) [ Primary button ] Status box: [Done] one-sentence conclusion + at most 3 points Key output: one table (with an h4 title) or one chart ▸ Detail 1   ▸ Detail 2   ▸ How to do it in R                                        [ Next step: ××× → ]

title: KIT design language
text: run, scroll status box top screen (smooth scrolling motion reduced). Show first successful result default; preselect one stopped. Actions change results clicked user; button states consequence clearly (「這一回合不做（題庫與連結不會改變）」, “Skip round (item bank linking change)”), leaves log entry.
code: Not available ──(previous step done)──▶ Available ──(click primary button)──▶ Running        ┌───────────────┬───────────────┬────────────┘        ▼               ▼               ▼     [Done]     [Done, but note]     [Stopped]        └───────┬───────┘     (fix and click again, or click "Skip this round")                ▼    "Next step" button appears; tab gets ✓ (later changes to settings or files → [Run again]; the tab's ✓ is removed, later tabs turn gray)

title: KIT design language
text: page must never scroll sideways: document.documentElement.scrollWidth must equal window width. Inputs tables get max-width: 100%. Tabs stay one row scroll sideways; wrap several rows. Tables cards become “one row per block, column name top” (data-label). header shrinks, first screen shows page guide first setting.

title: KIT design language
text: Taiwanese Traditional Chinese, short sentences, conversational casual; one sentence says one thing. subject 「你」 (“”) omitted; never 「使用者」 (“user”). Conclusion first, reason: 「這一回合資訊不足，無法估計：每個人在要估的題只剩一題。」 (“enough information estimate round: person one item left estimate.”) Numbers always carry units: 「688 人」 (“688 people”), 「3 個量尺」 (“3 scales”), 「2,058 欄」 (“2,058 columns”). Buttons start verb say clearly happen: 「開始校準」 (“Start calibration”), 「下載 CSV」 (“Download CSV”), 「到遺漏值處理頁改掉 →」 (“Fix missing value page →”); never 「確定」 (“OK”) 「送出」 (“Submit”). Error messages always say ; R’s original message goes 「▸ 原始訊息」 (“▸ Original message”). recommended option goes first, button says 「（建議）」 (“(recommended)”). Word list (one word per concept): Tab names “noun + verb”: 檔案上傳 (file upload), 遺漏值處理 (missing value handling), 資料串接 (data join), 格式轉換 (format conversion). Table column names: function output data keep English column names; summary tables app builds may use Chinese; downloaded files always keep original column names.

title: KIT design language
text: <html lang="zh-Hant-TW"> Body text 17px, smallest text 14px Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1; frames, focus outlines, graphics ≥ 3:1 Primary button ≥ 48px tall, regular button ≥ 40px, secondary button ≥ 36px, collapsible titles text links ≥ 32px, checkboxes 20px Keyboard operable, focus 3px focus outline State never relies color alone; always text offsets animation “reduce motion” Ligatures code 390px wide page scroll sideways

what: Using it in a new Shiny app
title: KIT design language
text: New apps longer copy files: just load kitDesign package. theme, styles (inst/www/*.css), browser-side scripts (inst/www/kit.js), logo package, every app uses copy. Add kitDesign Imports: app package’s DESCRIPTION. Start page like : kit_page() already sets lang = "zh-Hant-TW", kit_theme(), styles scripts (use_kit()), header (kit_header()). build page bslib::page_*(), add theme = kit_theme() use_kit(). start brand-new app: kit_new_app(path, title, subtitle) (includes header, step tabs, example tab written page skeleton, tests). Components come three kinds: Value objects (S3): kit_status (status box), kit_check／kit_checklist (checklist), kit_code (one version code). check content constructed (example, state can idle／success／warning／error／stale), render placed directly page passed renderUI(), print() shows text version. Modules (stateful components, *_ui(id) + *_server(id)): step tabs kit_step_tabs_*, step cards kit_stepcards_*, primary button + still needed kit_run_gate_*, R kit_code_panel_*. One line per page; state manage . Markup functions: components, plus low-level versions two kinds (older apps can switch gradually). function use component: every component looks like: kit_gallery(). tool name stays “KIT ×× 工具” (“KIT ×× tool”); rename testing data (example TDCYP). version line always header reads Version Date app’s DESCRIPTION (kit_app_description()), starting app’s package name (package =, e.g. “kitJoin v0.6.0 · 2026-10-31”); show_kitdesign = TRUE kitDesign version follows, versions visible reporting problems. Versioning rules release steps: release.md; old names kitJoin kitsUI: migration.md. new components style changes, change kitDesign (inst/www/kit-design.css R/); write separate CSS app. Use system’s tokens (colors, sp-*, type sizes), check existing component writing new one.

title: KIT design language
text: Tool name: stays “KIT”. TDCYP test data. Status labels: unified 【完成】【完成，但請注意】【停下來】【要重新執行】 (“Done”, “Done, note”, “Stopped”, “Run ”). Table column names: function output data keep English column names; summary tables package builds may use Chinese; downloaded files keep original column names. kitJoin tabs: three groups, unnumbered (準備 · 做出資料（選一個）· 其他工具; Prepare · Make data (pick one) · tools). code: score_server <- function(id, goto) {   moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {     run <- kit_run_gate_server("run", reactive(if (input$scale == "") "選量尺"))     status <- reactiveVal(kit_status())     result <- reactiveVal(NULL)      observeEvent(run(), {       st <- tryCatch({         df <- data.frame(id = 1:3, score = c(12, 15, 9))   # replace with real scoring         result(df)         kit_done_status(paste0("計分完成：", kit_num(nrow(df)), " 人。"))   # "Scoring done: N people."       }, error = function(e) kit_error_status(e, "計分"))       status(st)       kit_scroll_to("status")                  # results first, details after     }, ignoreInit = TRUE)      output$status <- renderUI(status())     output$result <- renderUI({       req(result())       tagList(         h4("分數"),         p(class = "kit-hint", kit_rows_note(nrow(result()), shown_rows = 10)),         kit_table_scroll(kit_static_table(head(result(), 10)))       )     })     kit_code_panel_server("code", function() list(       tidy = paste0("scores <- kits::kits_subj(X, item) |>\n",                     "  dplyr::filter(scale == \"", input$scale, "\")")     ))     output$next_step <- renderUI({       req(status()$state %in% c("success", "warning"))       kit_next_step("算好了。", session$ns("go"), "下一步：結果")   # "Done.", "Next: Results"     })     observeEvent(input$go, goto("result"))     list(state = reactive(status()$state))   }) } server <- function(input, output, session) {   goto <- function(tab) nav$select(tab)   score <- score_server("score", goto)   nav <- kit_step_tabs_server("nav", states = reactive(c(score = score$state()))) } shinyApp(ui, server)
